messages.author: JoshMD
messages.text: Making standing military give score allows you to sell your military, hit people smaller then you then rebuy at no cost as you get a full refund

messages.author: Justinian
messages.text: Selling military giving diminishing returns would also be an idea but this one discourages selling in the first place

messages.author: JoshMD
messages.text: I think there should be a punishment for selling but that vote already failed.

messages.author: JoshMD
messages.text: Well it was for buildings and land not troops I suppose

messages.author: Unknown Identity
messages.text: I mean we did try to implement no refund when selling buildings, provinces, cities etc.. but yall shot it down. 🤷‍♂️

messages.author: Unknown Identity
messages.text: If that had passed maybe it would have discouraged selling off.

messages.author: JoshMD
messages.text: Sad stuff indeed that the pass failed, though a lot of people who said no have since quit because their exploit got patched anyways

messages.author: JoshMD
messages.text: But either way standing military shouldn't contribute to war range

messages.author: JoshMD
messages.text: I will be abusing this until it is patched but I did my responsibility as a good player to report it

messages.author: Justinian
messages.text: I feel like that should allow a recount

messages.author: Dede
messages.text: We can if you resuggest it
